chunks: He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji'abi reported to me from Abul Abbas Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Saeed, who reported from Yahya ibn Zakariyya, who reported from Uthman ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Sulayman and Imran ibn Marwan, from Sama'ah ibn Mehran who said: I heard Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them both, saying:

Indeed the one whom Allah mentioned in His Book: 'And mention in the Book, Ismail; indeed he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger Prophet' -- Allah tested him with his people, who pulled off the skin of his face and scalp. Then Allah sent an angel to him who said: 'The Lord of the worlds greets you with peace and says: I have seen what your people have done to you, so ask Me whatever you wish.' He said: 'O Lord of the worlds, I have an ideal in the person of al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon them.'
Abu Abdillah (Imam al-Sadiq), peace be upon him, said: 'He was not Ismail the son of Ibrahim, peace be upon our Prophet and upon both of them.'

key_terms.إسماعيل: Ismail (a prophet, not the son of Ibrahim)

ai.seo_question: Who is the Ismail mentioned in Quran 19:54 according to Imam al-Sadiq, and why did he choose Imam Husayn as his ideal?
ai.summary: In this narration, Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) explains that the Ismail mentioned in Quran 19:54 -- 'And mention in the Book, Ismail; indeed he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger Prophet' -- was not Ismail the son of Ibrahim (a.s.), but a different prophet. This Ismail was severely tested by his people, who flayed the skin off his face and scalp. When Allah sent an angel offering him any wish, he replied that al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) was his ideal and role model. The hadith demonstrates that even earlier prophets recognized Imam Husayn's sacrifice as the ultimate model of patience.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 7. He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji’abi reported from Abul Abbas Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Saeed, who reported from Yahya ibn Zakariyya, who reported from Uthman ibn Isa, who reported from Ahmad ibn Sulayman and Imran ibn Marwan, from Sama’ah ibn Mehran who said: I heard Abu Abdillah Ja’far ibn Muhammad (as) say:

"The person mentioned by Allah in the verse: ’And mention in the Book, Ismail; indeed he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger Prophet.’ [19:54] he was the one who Allah tested by his people, so they pulled off the skin from his face and scalp. Then Allah sent His angel unto him, who said: "The Lord of the entire creation greets you with peace; and says: I have seen what your people have done to you, so ask Me whatever you want." He said: "O Lord of the worlds, I have an ideal in the person of al-Husayn ibn ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon them."
Then Abu Abdillah said: "He was not Ismail the son of Ibrahim, peace be upon our Prophet and upon both of them."
